scenarios.name: Untrusted User Prompt
scenarios.problem_scenario: Can a user submit free-form instructions or content to an AI assistant?
risk_identification: A malicious prompt may override intended behavior or exfiltrate protected context.
Prompt content may include secrets or regulated data that must not enter logs.
security_control_requirements: Treat every user prompt as untrusted data rather than an instruction to the platform.
Detect and block attempts to extract system prompts, secrets, or cross-tenant context.
Redact sensitive prompt content from application and model-provider logs.

scenarios.name: External Document RAG Ingestion
scenarios.problem_scenario: Can users upload or connect documents that become retrieval context for the AI assistant?
business_indicators: 上传文档到向量知识库
risk_identification: A poisoned document may manipulate retrieval results or inject hidden model instructions.
Missing tenant filters may disclose chunks from another customer corpus.
security_control_requirements: Scan and classify every document before adding it to the retrieval index.
Enforce tenant and access-control filters during both ingestion and retrieval.
Return source citations and support removal of every indexed document and chunk.

scenarios.name: Agent Tool Execution
scenarios.problem_scenario: Can model output cause an external tool or business action to execute?
risk_identification: Prompt injection may cause the agent to invoke a tool outside the user's intent.
Autonomous high-impact actions may execute without adequate human authorization.
security_control_requirements: Allow only explicitly registered tools with least-privilege scoped credentials.
Require human confirmation before every irreversible or high-impact action.
Validate tool arguments and record the prompt, decision, approver, and result.
